weekDays.description: Days a week must count for a weekly streak ([learner] week_days, default 4).

LearnerEvent.description: One event: `event` (a name), optionally `concept`, `hash`, `kind` (autodidactic, interactive or ai), `id` and `device`; the server stamps `at`.

body.description: Markdown: a list whose items each start with a link to a stop, then its narration.

enabled.description: Whether the teacher folder can be written (the learner record is on).

profileSet.description: False when guessed: set it in rdstudio.toml ([teacher] profile) or with rdstudio teacher profile.

history.description: The teacher folder's commits, newest first.

status.description: rdstudio's default, customised here, or written here with no default.

defaultChanged.description: Customised, and rdstudio's default has changed since.

base.description: The default the customisation was made from.

models.description: The model for each job ([teacher.models] in the user config).

actor.description: Who edits are attributed to, such as human:lachlan.

available.description: Whether the project is a git repository.

diff.description: The note then against now, as a unified diff, uncommitted changes included.

version.description: Of the whole file; send it back as `base` when saving.

to.description: The new id, such as philosophy/motivation.

base.description: The note's version; refused if it changed since.

backlinks.description: Notes that linked to it; those links are now broken.

base.description: The version the edit started from; null creates the note.

meta.description: Fields to set; null removes one.
